summary_markdown: The discussion centered on optimizing the calculation of campaign loads, particularly for campaigns with long durations (3 to 12 months). A suggestion was made by someone to calculate only one month's worth of load and multiply it. [me] suggested that the aggregates could be optimized to handle such extended periods. It was noted that further information is being gathered regarding this calculation method.
decisions: The proposed method for calculating campaign loads (calculating 1 month's load and multiplying) needs pre-discussion.
action_items: Discuss the optimization of campaign load calculations with relevant parties on Monday or Tuesday.
